jobs.description:
Who We Are:

The Micronesia Conservation Trust (MCT) is a non-governmental, non-profit conservation finance organization established to provide sustainable financing for conservation and community development across Micronesia. MCT has a 24-year institutional history and serves as a regional hub for conservation finance across the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM), Palau, the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the broader Micronesian sub-region.

Under an agreement with the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), MCT has been contracted to serve as the National Host Institution (NHI) for the Global Environment Facility (GEF) Small Grants Program (SGP) in the FSM. The SGP supports civil society organizations and community groups to implement projects that address global environmental challenges – including biodiversity loss, land degradation, climate change, and threats to international waters – in ways that enhance local livelihoods and community well-being.

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Small Grants Programme Manager is responsible for the effective, transparent, and accountable
implementation of the GEF SGP in the FSM. The Manager will ensure that grant resources are directed to eligible, high-impact projects; that grantee organizations are adequately supported throughout the project cycle; and that program results are documented and reported in accordance with UNDP/GEF requirements.

We’re Looking for You:

MCT is seeking to recruit a qualified and experienced Small Grants Program Manager to lead the day-to-day implementation of the SGP-FSM. This role will be based in Chuuk State and will work closely with MCT leadership, a national technical review body, UNDP, GEF, and community stakeholders across the FSM.

What You’ll Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, natural resource management, development studies, public administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in program or project management, preferably in grant-making, conservation, or community development.
Demonstrated experience in grants management, including proposal review, due diligence, contracting, disbursement tracking, and reporting.
Experience working with or within civil society organizations, government agencies, or international development organizations in the Pacific Islands region.
Strong written and oral communication skills in English; proficiency in a Micronesian language is an advantage.
Demonstrated proficiency in financial management and basic accounting practices related to grant administration.
Ability to travel regularly within FSM states, including to remote island communities.

Desired Qualifications:

Familiarity with GEF, UNDP, or other multilateral environmental fund requirements and procedures.
Experience with community-based natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, or related thematic areas.
Experience designing or applying monitoring and evaluation frameworks for development or conservation programs.
Demonstrated cultural competency and experience engaging with Indigenous communities and traditional governance structures in Micronesia or the broader Pacific.

What We Bring:

MCT is a world-class conservation trust, the smallest organization to be accredited by the Green Climate Fund and the Adaptation Fund, and it manages over $50 million in assets. We offer a competitive, comprehensive salary and benefits package.

How to Apply:

Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following:
A cover letter (maximum two pages) addressing their qualifications and suitability for the position.
A current curriculum vitae.
Contact information for three professional references.
A brief writing sample (maximum five pages) demonstrating relevant analytical or reporting experience.

Address your application to Melanie Aiseam, CFOO, and email all documents to Lovelynn at
ledgar@ourmicronesia.org by 5:00 pm Pohnpei Time (UTC+11) on September 25, 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

About PriceEasy

PriceEasy is an AI-powered retail intelligence company transforming how convenience retailers make decisions.
We work with leading retail organizations around the world, combining massive volumes of transaction, pricing, competitive, market, location, and external data to help retailers make smarter decisions and improve their operations.
We are looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious Business Strategy Analyst
who can turn complex data into powerful business insights.
The Role

Can you find the one insight hidden in millions of transactions that changes how a retailer operates?

As a Strategic Analyst at PriceEasy, you will work with large and diverse datasets to answer some of the most important questions facing our clients.
Why are sales declining at certain locations?
Which promotions are actually driving incremental sales?
Which products are performing above or below their potential?
How do pricing, competition, demographics, weather, traffic, and market conditions affect performance?
Where should a retailer open its next location?
What separates the highest-performing stores from the rest of the network?
Your job will go beyond creating reports and dashboards. You will find the story behind the data, identify opportunities, and translate your analysis into recommendations that can materially improve our clients’ businesses.

You will work with PriceEasy’s Customer Success, Product, Data, and leadership teams and have opportunities to present your insights directly to clients.
What You Will Do

Analyze Customer Transaction Data

Analyze millions of retail transactions to understand sales trends, customer behavior, product performance, basket composition, pricing, margins, and store-level performance.
Identify patterns, anomalies, correlations, and opportunities that traditional reporting may miss.
Evaluate Promotions and Retail Performance

Analyze promotional campaigns to determine what worked, what didn’t, and why.
Measure incremental sales, customer response, product performance, pricing effectiveness, and promotional ROI.
Help clients determine which promotions should be expanded, modified, or discontinued.
Analyze Markets and Competition

Combine internal client data with external datasets including competitive pricing, demographics, traffic, mobility, weather, market trends, and geographic information.
Identify how external factors influence store performance and uncover opportunities or risks within individual markets.
Identify High-Potential Locations

Use location, demographic, competitive, traffic, and performance data to help identify attractive markets and potential new retail locations.
Analyze existing networks to understand what characteristics differentiate successful locations from underperforming ones.
Benchmark Performance

Compare locations, markets, products, categories, and promotions to identify best practices and performance gaps.
Answer questions such as: What are the best stores doing differently?

Turn Data Into Strategy

The most important part of your job is not producing the analysis — it is determining what the analysis means.

Translate complex findings into clear recommendations that executives and operators can act on.
Build compelling presentations and executive-level analyses that explain the What, Why, and What Should We Do Next?

Become a Strategic Partner to Our Clients

Develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses and use data to proactively identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability, pricing, promotions, and operations.
Our goal is for you to become a thought partner to our clients
, not simply an analyst.
What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious and loves solving complex business problems with data.
Required:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related quantitative/business discipline

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work comfortably with large and complex datasets
Strong understanding of business and economics
Advanced Excel skills
Strong ability to communicate analytical findings in simple business language
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to create compelling presentations and communicate with senior executives
Ability to work from our Houston office five days per week

Preferred:

SQL experience
Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Knowledge of statistics, econometrics, forecasting, or predictive analytics
Experience analyzing retail, consumer, pricing, transaction, or location data
Experience in consulting, strategy, business analytics, retail analytics, or a similar analytical environment
Familiarity with AI and modern analytical tools

Who Will Excel in This Role

You may be a great fit if you are the type of person who receives a dataset and immediately starts asking:
Why is this happening?

What is driving this trend?

What are we missing?

What other data could help explain this?

What decision should the client make because of this insight?

We want someone who isn’t satisfied with reporting that sales declined 8%.
We want the person who can determine why they declined, what is causing it, and what the client should do about it.

Why PriceEasy

At PriceEasy, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, economics, data science, strategy, and retail.

You will analyze real-world business problems using large and diverse datasets and see your recommendations influence decisions across major retail organizations.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to develop beyond traditional analytics and become a strategic advisor capable of using data to transform how businesses operate.

MCT is seeking to recruit a qualified and experienced Small Grants Program Manager to lead the day-to-day implementation of the SGP-FSM. Experience with community-based natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, or related thematic areas.

Demonstrated cultural competency and experience engaging with Indigenous communities and traditional governance structures in Micronesia or the broader Pacific.

About PriceEasy

PriceEasy is an AI-powered retail intelligence company transforming how convenience retailers make decisions.

The Role

Can you find the one insight hidden in millions of transactions that changes how a retailer operates?

As a Strategic Analyst at PriceEasy, you will work with large and diverse datasets to answer some of the most important questions facing our clients.
Why are sales declining at certain locations?
Which promotions are actually driving incremental sales?
Which products are performing above or below their potential?
How do pricing, competition, demographics, weather, traffic, and market conditions affect performance?
Where should a retailer open its next location?
What separates the highest-performing stores from the rest of the network?
Your job will go beyond creating reports and dashboards. You will find the story behind the data, identify opportunities, and translate your analysis into recommendations that can materially improve our clients’ businesses.

You will work with PriceEasy’s Customer Success, Product, Data, and leadership teams and have opportunities to present your insights directly to clients.
What You Will Do

Analyze Customer Transaction Data

Analyze millions of retail transactions to understand sales trends, customer behavior, product performance, basket composition, pricing, margins, and store-level performance.
Identify patterns, anomalies, correlations, and opportunities that traditional reporting may miss.
Evaluate Promotions and Retail Performance

Analyze promotional campaigns to determine what worked, what didn’t, and why.
Measure incremental sales, customer response, product performance, pricing effectiveness, and promotional ROI.
Help clients determine which promotions should be expanded, modified, or discontinued.
Analyze Markets and Competition

Combine internal client data with external datasets including competitive pricing, demographics, traffic, mobility, weather, market trends, and geographic information.
Identify how external factors influence store performance and uncover opportunities or risks within individual markets.
Identify High-Potential Locations

Use location, demographic, competitive, traffic, and performance data to help identify attractive markets and potential new retail locations.
Analyze existing networks to understand what characteristics differentiate successful locations from underperforming ones.
Benchmark Performance

Compare locations, markets, products, categories, and promotions to identify best practices and performance gaps.
Answer questions such as: What are the best stores doing differently?

Turn Data Into Strategy

The most important part of your job is not producing the analysis — it is determining what the analysis means.

Translate complex findings into clear recommendations that executives and operators can act on.
Build compelling presentations and executive-level analyses that explain the What, Why, and What Should We Do Next?

Become a Strategic Partner to Our Clients

Develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses and use data to proactively identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability, pricing, promotions, and operations.
Our goal is for you to become a thought partner to our clients
, not simply an analyst.
What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious and loves solving complex business problems with data.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related quantitative/business discipline

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work comfortably with large and complex datasets
Strong understanding of business and economics
Advanced Excel skills
Strong ability to communicate analytical findings in simple business language
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to create compelling presentations and communicate with senior executives
Ability to work from our Houston office five days per week

Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Knowledge of statistics, econometrics, forecasting, or predictive analytics
Experience analyzing retail, consumer, pricing, transaction, or location data
Experience in consulting, strategy, business analytics, retail analytics, or a similar analytical environment
Familiarity with AI and modern analytical tools

Who Will Excel in This Role

You may be a great fit if you are the type of person who receives a dataset and immediately starts asking:
Why is this happening?

What is driving this trend?

What are we missing?

What other data could help explain this?

What decision should the client make because of this insight?

We want someone who isn’t satisfied with reporting that sales declined 8%.
We want the person who can determine why they declined, what is causing it, and what the client should do about it.

Why PriceEasy

At PriceEasy, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, economics, data science, strategy, and retail.

You will analyze real-world business problems using large and diverse datasets and see your recommendations influence decisions across major retail organizations.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to develop beyond traditional analytics and become a strategic advisor capable of using data to transform how businesses operate.

• Conduct quantitative research using statistical, mathematical, and computational methods.

• Analyze financial, market, and alternative datasets to identify patterns and opportunities.

• Develop, test, and refine quantitative models and analytical frameworks.

• Perform statistical analysis, forecasting, and scenario analysis.

• Research market trends, asset behavior, and investment strategies.

• Develop and backtest quantitative trading or investment strategies.

• Evaluate model performance, assumptions, risks, and limitations.

• Build financial models and analytical tools to support investment decisions.

• Clean, process, and validate large datasets from multiple sources.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate research findings.

• Monitor quantitative models and performance metrics on an ongoing basis.

• Collaborate with investment, technology, risk, and research teams.

• Document research methodologies, model assumptions, findings, and recommendations.

✅ Requirements

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is preferred.

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates with strong quantitative backgrounds are welcome to apply.

• Strong mathematical, statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Solid understanding of probability, statistics, financial markets, and quantitative methods.

• Experience with Python, R, MATLAB, SQL, or other programming languages is an advantage.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.

• Familiarity with financial modeling, time-series analysis, or quantitative research is preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large and complex datasets.

• Ability to translate complex quantitative findings into clear insights.

• Strong research, critical-thinking, and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

🌟 What We Offer

• Direct exposure to quantitative research and data-driven investment analysis.

• Opportunity to work with financial markets, advanced datasets, and quantitative models.

• Career progression into Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, Risk Analyst, or Portfolio Analytics roles.

• Training, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.

• Exposure to advanced analytical techniques and financial technologies.

• A challenging, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating environment.

• Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
